bagPolicy.summary: When the clear bag policy is in effect, clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. It applies to all NFL games.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5", with or without a strap
Clear diaper bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
bagPolicy.note: Each concert states on its event page whether the clear bag policy applies, and the size limit can change by tour. Recent concerts such as Billy Joel and Stevie Nicks used it. Each guest may carry one clear bag plus one clutch. Medically necessary items are allowed after inspection and tagging. Express lanes are open for guests without bags.

parking.note: Caesars Superdome offers parking in seven garages and two surface lots, with pre-purchase options available through JustPark EventPass. Long-term monthly parking is available in Garage 5 and Champions Garage for $125 via EFT.

rideshare.note: Use Poydras Street between Clara Street and Loyola Avenue for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Check your event page for any location changes.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Caesars Superdome varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The ADA Facilitator can be contacted at (504) 587-3826 or ada@caesarssuperdome.com. Wheelchairs may be checked out at the Guest Relations Center located at Gate F on the Plaza Level.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Caesars Superdome's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Prior to event day, Will Call is located at the Smoothie King Center Box Office. On event day, Will Call is located at the Superdome Box Office at Gate A Ground.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The Superdome uses OpenGate technology and walk-through metal detectors at all entry gates to enhance safety and security at public ticketed events.
